# Mistral AI Dart Client

> Dart client for the Mistral AI API with chat completions, streaming, tool calling, multimodal inputs, TTS, voice management, reasoning effort, embeddings, OCR, and more.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/README.md) (~6.9k tokens): Primary package documentation with installation, configuration, and usage examples.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/CHANGELOG.md) (~6.1k tokens): Release history and version-by-version changes.
- [MIGRATION](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/MIGRATION.md) (~4.9k tokens): Upgrade notes and breaking-change guidance.

## Examples

- [chat_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/chat_example.dart) (~625 tokens): Chat completions, token scores, and Priority Tier.
- [streaming_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/streaming_example.dart) (~267 tokens): Streaming responses.
- [responses_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/responses_example.dart): Stateless generation, SSE and input token counts.
- [vision_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/vision_example.dart) (~476 tokens): Multimodal inputs.
- [tool_calling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/tool_calling_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Tool calling.
- [json_mode_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/json_mode_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Structured output.
- [embeddings_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/embeddings_example.dart) — Text and multimodal embeddings with optional base64 output.
- [fim_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/fim_example.dart) (~749 tokens): Code completion.
- [models_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/models_example.dart) (~892 tokens): Model listing.
- [files_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/files_example.dart) (~857 tokens): Multipart file uploads and signed downloads.
- [fine_tuning_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/fine_tuning_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Existing fine-tuned model management.
- [moderation_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/moderation_example.dart) (~879 tokens): Content moderation.
- [ocr_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/ocr_example.dart) — OCR 4.1 document extraction and block confidence.
- [audio_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/audio_example.dart) (~1.1k tokens): Voxtral file transcription, SSE, speech generation, voice search, and sample downloads.
- [realtime_audio_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/realtime_audio_example.dart): Realtime Voxtral transcription and speech over WebSockets.
- [agents_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/agents_example.dart) (~1.6k tokens): Legacy Agents API (beta), including cursor pagination.
- [conversations_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/conversations_example.dart) (~1.7k tokens): Legacy Conversations API (beta) with typed SSE and history.
- [libraries_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/libraries_example.dart) (~2.2k tokens): Multipart library documents and access (beta).
- [prompts_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/prompts_example.dart): Versioned prompt templates (beta).
- [skills_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/skills_example.dart): Versioned skills and workspace sharing (beta).
- [connectors_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/connectors_example.dart) — MCP and HTTP connector lifecycle and tool discovery.
- [managed_search_indexes_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/managed_search_indexes_example.dart): Mistral-hosted index search (Public Preview).
- [observability_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/observability_example.dart) — Enterprise Public Preview projects, datasets, scorers, and telemetry.
- [workflows_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/workflows_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Workflow execution, scheduling, and management.
- [workflow_deployment_archive_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/workflow_deployment_archive_example.dart): Signed archive upload and managed deployment (Public Preview).
- [error_handling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/error_handling_example.dart) (~893 tokens): Exception handling patterns.
- [batch_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/batch_example.dart) (~1.9k tokens): Batch polling, filters, and inline results.
- [classification_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/classification_example.dart) — Text and chat classification with configured target scores.
- [config_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/config_example.dart) (~844 tokens): Client configuration options.
- [multi_turn_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/multi_turn_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Multi-turn conversation management.
- [parallel_requests_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/parallel_requests_example.dart) (~1k tokens): Parallel and concurrent requests.
- [rag_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/rag_example.dart) (~2.1k tokens): Retrieval Augmented Generation.
- [semantic_search_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/semantic_search_example.dart) (~1.6k tokens): Semantic search with embeddings.
- [system_message_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/system_message_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): System message patterns.
- [platform_identity_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/platform_identity_example.dart) — Caller identity, user memberships, billing, and service-account roles.
- [workflow_trigger_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/workflow_trigger_example.dart) — Inbound provider webhooks and workflow trigger events.

- [admin_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/admin_example.dart): Organization roles and workspaces using an Enterprise Preview Admin API key.
